name: meetingburner
description: Put Claude in a live MeetingBurner meeting as a disclosed agent: join, take notes, post decisions and action items, and summarise the meeting afterwards.

api_key.title: MeetingBurner API key
api_key.description: Starts with mb_. Create one at meetingburner.com: Settings, Developer, Create API Key. Tick 'Create meetings' and 'Read past meetings' if you want those skills.
